raw_response:
My land is 13.1 mu. I plant wheat and corn on about 10 mu, that is my main field, wheat in winter then corn after wheat harvest. The other 3.1 mu I keep for cotton — that piece is on the side where water comes a bit slower, cotton does alright there.

I am 61 years old, I never went to school, but I have been farming this land for 40 years. I do what works. My husband and sons help, and some of the young ones work in town so money comes in from there too — that is good because fertilizer is not cheap anymore.

For wheat, I put down two bags of compound fertilizer before planting, that is about 100 jin per mu, and then when the wheat turns green in spring I throw urea, maybe 30 jin per mu. My neighbor Old Wang does the same. If I put less, the wheat looks yellow and I worry. Better to spend the extra money than have a thin crop. I water three times — once after planting if dry, once at jointing, once at filling. I spray for aphids and the yellow rust twice. I expect about 900 jin per mu if the weather is good, sometimes less.

For corn after wheat, I use the hybrid seed from the shop in the village, the one everyone buys — Zhengdan or whatever they sell me, I trust the dealer, he has not cheated me. I put compound fertilizer at planting and urea at the big growth time when the corn is knee-high. I water twice if the rain does not come. One spray for the borer worm. Corn here gives me 1100 jin per mu usually.

Cotton is more trouble. I buy the Bt seed, the one that does not need so much spray for the bollworm — but I still spray many times for the other bugs, aphids, mites, the small ones. I put fertilizer before planting and then some more when the buds come. Cotton takes my time all summer, picking by hand with my daughter-in-law. I get maybe 450 jin of seed cotton per mu, the price moves up and down, I cannot control that.

For all my land I use the small rotary machine — I hire it from the man in the village, he comes with his tractor. I do not plough deep anymore, rotary is enough, that is what everyone does now.
